Title: General availability: Encryption using CMK for Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server uses storage encryption of data at-rest for data using service managed encryption keys in limited Azure regions. Your data, including backups, are encrypted on disk and this encryption is always on and can't be disabled. The encryption uses FIPS 140-2 validated cryptographic module and an AES 256-bit cipher for your Azure storage encryption. This feature is now available in all public Azure regions.

Learn more.
